Remodeling Homes Across Scottsdale With Precision And Purpose

Scottsdale homes reflect a wide range of architectural styles; from contemporary desert builds to established custom residences. Remodeling in this environment requires attention to detail, cohesive design planning, and material selections that elevate the entire home.

At Premier Design-Build-Remodel, we guide Scottsdale homeowners through a structured design-build process that aligns vision with execution. Every remodel is planned with intention; ensuring layout, finishes, and structural updates work together seamlessly.

When remodeling is approached comprehensively, the result feels elevated rather than incremental.

Remodeling Services We Offer In Scottsdale

Our Scottsdale team provides full-service residential remodeling, including:

Kitchen Remodeling in Scottsdale
Custom layouts, premium cabinetry, structural reconfiguration, and high-performance appliance integration.
Bathroom Remodeling in Scottsdale
Spa-inspired primary suites, luxury finishes, and precision tile craftsmanship.
Whole Home Remodeling in Scottsdale
Cohesive transformations that unify architecture, materials, and systems.
Casitas & Home Additions in Scottsdale
Detached guest homes, expansions, and structural additions designed for seamless integration.

Each project follows our structured 6-step design-build model; creating clarity before construction begins.

Visit Our Scottsdale Showroom

Remodeling at a higher level requires informed material selection.

At our Scottsdale showroom, homeowners can explore:

Custom cabinetry displays
Premium countertop materials
Designer tile collections
Lighting installations
Plumbing fixtures and hardware
Coordinated finish palettes

Meeting with our design team in person allows you to compare materials, evaluate combinations, and move into the planning phase with confidence.

Seeing and touching materials firsthand transforms decisions from theoretical to intentional.

Why Scottsdale Homeowners Choose Premier

Remodeling in Scottsdale often involves higher customization, detailed finish work, and architectural coordination.

Homeowners choose Premier because we provide:

A fully integrated design-build structure
Defined scope before construction
Structured communication and scheduling
Experience with city permitting requirements
Showroom-based material selection support

By managing design and construction under one accountable team, we maintain alignment from concept to completion.

Complimentary Consultation
Meet with our design team in the Scottsdale showroom to discuss vision, layout possibilities, and next steps.
Discovery & Measurement
In-home evaluation, measurements, and documentation to refine scope.

WHO WE ARE
Decades of Remodeling Excellence in Arizona
Meet Our Team
A dedicated design-build team serving homeowners across the Phoenix metro area.
Greg Heden
President
Greg Heden is the visionary leader behind Premier Design-Build-Remodel. Since founding the company in 1994, Greg has earned a reputation for excellence by blending innovative design, superior craftsmanship, and expert project management.
Kent Redmond
VP Production & Operations
Kent Redmond’s 33-year career in residential project management is defined by his exceptional leadership, problem-solving, and high-level communication. He has a proven track record of successfully managing a wide range of residential projects.
Kym Davis
VP Sales & Design
Kym still maintains his passion for residential remodeling after 45 years because it revolves around families adapting their homes to fit their lifestyles. As he’s gotten older, his talents and interests have evolved from the “designer” role to “mentor.
Stephanie Olesen-Bute, NCIDQ
Interior Designer
Originally from the Midwest, Stephanie holds a Bachelor of Fine Arts in Interior Design from the Illinois Institute of Art–Chicago. A nationally certified NCIDQ designer with over 25 years’ experience, she creates functional, client-reflective spaces, drawing inspiration from travel, yoga, and Pilates.
Rachel Herrera
Design Consultant
Rachel dedicated years to learning the tile installation trade and eventually grew her team as word of her skills spread quickly. Her business flourished with the support of local homeowners, and she built a remodeling business with a focus on tile design.
Chris Ebert
Design Consultant
Chris brings over 35 years of experience to the design industry, where his journey began in the creative hub of Chicago, Illinois. With a personalized approach to each project, Chris ensures that every client achieves a unique and tailored space to call their own.
Julian Barabash
Project Development Advisor
Julian is a trusted advisor known for discretion, discernment, and unwavering client focus. He brings clarity to complex decisions, offering guidance rather than influence, so clients move forward with confidence. Built on trust and transparency, his approach ensures every decision is thoughtful, deliberate, and rooted in lasting peace of mind.

OUR PROCESS
Decades of Remodeling Excellence in Arizona
Complimentary Design Consultation

Your journey begins with a personalized one-hour consultation, typically held in our showroom, where inspiration comes to life. During this meeting, you’ll meet with one of our designers to help us understand your lifestyle, needs, and the motivations behind your unique remodeling project. This relaxed and informative session lays the groundwork for your remodel.

Experience our wide array of materials, finishes, and displays for inspiration
Digital presentation of our process, portfolio, and investment ranges
Honest conversation about your goals, style preferences, and budget window
Clear next steps for moving into the Discovery Phase with confidence
Discovery & Initial Site Measurement

Next, we start by bringing the conversation to your home. This phase is about gathering the details we need to start shaping your project. We’ll take photos, measurements, discuss layout possibilities, and present simple floor plan options to refine the direction back in the showroom. At the showroom, we’ll discuss:

Preliminary finishes and product ideas introduced
One or two simple design presentations with options that fit your budget window
A narrowed, more accurate investment range that sets the stage for design development
Design, Renderings & Detailed Selections

With the foundation in place, we dive into design. This is where your project comes to life through drawings, 3D renderings, and detailed selections. Our designers work closely with you through multiple meetings to refine layouts, perfect finishes, and confirm every detail before construction.

Guided selection meetings for cabinetry, countertops, flooring, fixtures, and more
Fully rendered drawings and 3D visualizations of your remodel
Multiple design review and revision sessions to fine-tune your vision
A fixed-price proposal so you know exactly what to expect before moving forward
Work Contract Acceptance & Signing

When you are feeling confident about the design and pricing and ready to proceed, it’s time to discuss the final details! The contract signing marks the official transition from planning to production, giving you a clear roadmap for the next phase.

Review and acceptance of the Construction Agreement
Signing of final design documents
Clear outline of next steps, including handoff to our production team during an in-home review.
Confidence that every detail is locked in before construction begins
Production, In-Home Project Construction

This is where vision becomes reality. Before construction starts, we’ll host an in-home project review so you can meet the production team, walk through the plan, and confirm final details. From there, construction begins—executed with precision, communication, and expert craftsmanship.

Ordering and review of all materials, products, and custom pieces
In-Home Project Review with your Project Manager to answer questions
Careful scheduling, pre-construction planning, and blueprint verification
Professional construction with ongoing site visits and communication
Project Completion & Enjoyment

The final step is all about celebrating your new space and making sure every detail is perfect. We’ll complete a thorough walkthrough with you, resolve any punch-list items, and capture professional photos of your finished remodel.

Final walkthrough to confirm your remodel meets expectations
Punch-list completion to ensure flawless results
Professional photography of your finished space
Follow-up support from the Premier team, beyond the project
Ready to Start Planning Your Remodel?
If you’re ready to start exploring possibilities for your home, our team is here to guide you through the next step.

BATHROOM REMODELING
Bathroom Remodeling in Mesa & Scottsdale, AZ
REQUEST CONSULTATION
A Better Way To Remodel Your Bathroom

A bathroom remodel should feel exciting, not overwhelming.

With the right structure, the process becomes organized, collaborative, and intentional. Decisions are made with clarity. Timelines are realistic. Craftsmanship is never rushed.

At Premier Design-Build-Remodel, we approach bathroom remodeling differently. As a true design-build firm serving Mesa, Scottsdale, and the East Valley, we bring design, planning, construction, and long-term support together under one roof; creating a smoother experience from concept to completion. If you are planning a bathroom remodel in Mesa, AZ, start at our Mesa showroom on Baseline Rd.

When one coordinated team guides the entire project, homeowners gain confidence at every stage.

Bathroom Remodeling Built Around Clarity And Craftsmanship
Design First, Not Demolition First

Every successful remodel begins with thoughtful planning. We take time to understand how you use your space, what isn’t working, and what would elevate your daily routine. Layout refinement, storage optimization, and guided material selections happen before construction begins; not during it.

One Coordinated Team

Designers, project managers, and installers work together from day one. There are no disconnected vendors and no confusion about responsibility. Communication stays streamlined, and each stage builds logically on the last.

Precision Execution

From tile alignment to custom cabinetry installation, details matter. Our team prioritizes craftsmanship, clean job sites, and respectful in-home practices; ensuring the finished space reflects both quality and care.

Luxury Bathroom Remodeling

For many homeowners in Mesa and Scottsdale, a bathroom remodel is about more than updating finishes; it’s about creating a personal retreat.

Luxury bathroom remodeling may include:

Custom walk-in showers with frameless glass
Freestanding soaking tubs
Designer lighting and layered illumination
Custom vanities with integrated storage
Premium tile and stone surfaces
Steam showers and heated floor systems
Luxurious custom closet solutions

Every element is selected with longevity and cohesion in mind. The result is a space that feels refined, functional, and tailored to your lifestyle.

Small Bathroom Remodel Ideas & Solutions

A smaller footprint doesn’t limit potential; it just requires smarter design.

For compact bathrooms, we focus on:

Space-saving layout adjustments
Walk-in shower conversions
Vertical storage solutions
Floating vanities for visual openness
Strategic lighting to enhance dimension
Creative storage solutions

Through careful planning and material selection, even a modestly sized bathroom can feel elevated and efficient.

Shower & Tub Remodeling Options

Whether you’re replacing an outdated tub, converting to a walk-in shower, or upgrading both, we tailor the design to your goals.

Common upgrades include:

Tub-to-shower conversions
Custom tile selections and layouts
Built-in niches and bench seating
High-performance shower possibilities
Accessibility-focused enhancements

Every shower and tub installation is coordinated within the full remodeling plan; ensuring structural integrity, waterproofing precision, and long-term durability.

How Much Does A Bathroom Remodel Cost?

Bathroom remodeling costs vary based on scope, design complexity, and finish selections. In Mesa, Scottsdale, and throughout the Phoenix metro area, investment ranges depend less on square footage alone and more on customization level and behind-the-wall adjustments.

Rather than providing rough estimates upfront, Premier follows a structured design-build process to clarify layout, materials, and scope before construction begins. This allows us to provide realistic investment guidance tailored to your home.

What Impacts The Cost Of A Bathroom Remodel?
Layout modifications or plumbing relocation
Custom tile showers and specialty fixtures
Cabinetry design and storage solutions
Material quality and brand selection
Structural or system updates in older homes

During your consultation, we walk through scope-based pricing, timeline expectations, and material allowances; ensuring clarity before any work begins.

Our goal is transparency, not surprises.

Our 6-Step Bathroom Remodeling Process
Complimentary Consultation
Begin with a relaxed consultation in our Mesa or Scottsdale showroom. We discuss goals, explore materials, and outline what your remodeling journey will look like. You’ll leave with clarity on next steps.
Discovery & Measurement
We visit your home to take measurements, document existing conditions, and evaluate layout opportunities. This phase helps narrow scope and establish a realistic investment range.
Design & Renderings
Detailed plans, 3D renderings, and curated material selections bring your vision into focus. Every decision is finalized before construction begins, ensuring alignment and confidence.
Contract Signing
Once design and scope are approved, we formalize the agreement and lock in scheduling. This step transitions your project from planning into production.
Construction Work
Before construction begins, we review the plan in your home with the production team. From there, coordinated scheduling and precise craftsmanship guide the build phase.
Project Completion
We complete a final walkthrough, confirm every detail meets expectations, and provide ongoing support. Your remodeled bathroom is delivered with clarity and care.
Is A Design-Build Bathroom Remodel Right For You?
A Great Fit If You:
Want a fully managed, start-to-finish experience
Value craftsmanship and premium finishes
Prefer making selections in a professional showroom setting
Plan to invest in your home long-term
Not The Right Fit If You:
Are looking for the lowest bid available
Prefer to coordinate separate contractors yourself
Need a quick cosmetic update rather than a structured remodel

Layout transitions between spaces

Lighting strategy throughout the home

Sightlines and natural light flow

This holistic approach prevents design fragmentation and creates a seamless living environment.

Removing walls for open-concept layouts

Updating outdated floor plans

These changes require careful engineering, permitting, and phased construction planning; all managed within our structured process.

A whole home remodel may include:

Electrical panel upgrades

Smart home integration

Whether you’re planning a detached guest casita, a primary suite expansion, or a full home addition, the key is integration. The new space should feel like it has always belonged.

Casitas & Detached Guest Homes

Casitas, also known as guest houses or accessory dwelling units (ADUs), offer flexibility for:

Multi-generational living
Private guest accommodations
Rental income potential
Home office or studio space

A well-designed casita requires more than framing and finishes. It involves:

Utility connections
Zoning considerations
Structural planning
Independent living functionality

Our team manages design, permitting, and construction coordination to ensure your detached space integrates seamlessly with your property.

Home Additions That Feel Seamless

Common home addition projects include:

Primary suite expansions
Second-story additions
Extended living rooms
Enlarged kitchens
Garage conversions
Sunroom enclosures

Each addition is designed to blend with your existing structure; from rooflines and exterior finishes to interior transitions and material continuity.

Structural Planning & Permitting In Arizona

Unlike interior remodels, home additions involve deeper structural and regulatory considerations.

Projects often require:

Engineering review
Foundation planning
Framing modifications
Utility rerouting
City permitting and inspections

Because our team operates within a comprehensive design-build model, these elements are coordinated early; reducing delays and improving timeline accuracy.

Realistic investment ranges

REQUEST YOUR COMPLIMENTARY CONSULTATION
Plan The Work Behind Your Mesa Remodel

A remodeling plan needs to address the room layout, material selections, budget, and work behind the walls. In Mesa, structural, electrical, and plumbing modifications require permits. We document existing conditions and develop the design before construction, so the project starts with a defined scope rather than unfinished decisions.

Replacing cabinets and countertops is a different project from relocating plumbing or removing a structural wall. We work through those differences during planning, connecting the changes you want with the construction they require.

Kitchen, Bathroom And Whole Home Remodeling In Mesa, AZ

Our Mesa remodeling services cover kitchens, bathrooms, whole-home renovations, casitas, and home additions. Each project connects design decisions with construction requirements. Whether you need better kitchen storage or additional living space, our team develops the layout, coordinates material selections, and plans the work before construction begins.

Kitchen Remodel In Mesa, AZ

Improve appliance placement, island seating, cabinetry, countertops, and storage. We evaluate traffic flow and circulation space before selecting finishes, so the design addresses how you actually use your kitchen.

Bathroom Remodel In Mesa, AZ

Bathroom remodeling in Mesa usually starts with one of three goals: replacing an outdated tub, adding a walk-in shower, or rethinking the vanity and storage layout. As a design-build firm, we plan the layout, plumbing locations and finish selections together before any demolition begins, so the design and the construction scope match.

At our Mesa showroom you can compare tile, plumbing fixtures, vanities, countertops and lighting side by side with a designer. Seeing shower and tub options next to the cabinetry and flooring you are considering makes it easier to approve selections with confidence.

See our full bathroom remodeling process, shower and tub options, and cost factors.

Whole Home Remodeling in Mesa
Bring connected rooms together through coordinated flooring, lighting, finishes, and layout changes. We plan structural modifications and electrical or plumbing upgrades alongside the visible improvements.
Casitas & Home Additions in Mesa
Build a detached guest casita, expand a primary suite, or add living space. Planning addresses utility connections, structural requirements, permitting, and how the new space fits your existing property.

Each project follows our structured 6-step design-build process to ensure clarity from consultation through completion.

Visit Our Kitchen And Bath Showroom In Mesa

Our Mesa kitchen and bath showroom lets you compare materials with a designer before approving your selections. Explore cabinetry, countertops, tile, flooring, plumbing fixtures, hardware, and lighting. We discuss how those choices work together and connect them with your room layout, project priorities, and next steps.

Compare cabinet styles and storage solutions alongside countertop surfaces and coordinated finishes. Seeing the materials together gives you a more useful starting point than choosing each finish separately.

Our 6-Step Remodeling Process
Our six-step remodeling process moves from consultation and in-home measurements to detailed design, a construction agreement, the build, and project completion. Drawings and material selections are developed before construction. An in-home project review then connects the approved plan with the production team responsible for carrying out the work.
Complimentary Consultation
Meet a designer for a complimentary, one-hour showroom consultation covering your remodeling goals, style preferences, and initial budget.
Discovery & Measurement
We photograph and measure your home, evaluate layout options, and narrow the project scope before detailed design begins.
Design & Renderings
Review drawings, 3D renderings, and material selections. We refine the design and prepare a fixed-price proposal for the planned work.
Contract Signing
Approve the construction agreement and final design documents before your project moves into production planning.
Construction Work
Meet your project manager during an in-home review. Our team coordinates materials, scheduling, construction, and communication.
Project Completion
Walk through the finished project with our team. We address punch-list items and provide follow-up support after completion.
Why Mesa Homeowners Choose Premier

Premier Design-Build-Remodel brings design, material selection, project management, and installation together within one company. Founded by Greg Heden in 1994, Premier employs designers, project managers, and craftspeople who coordinate the work. You work with an established remodeling team instead of arranging each trade and product supplier yourself.

A defined scope before construction. Completed plans and specified materials establish what the construction agreement covers. Your project manager provides a construction calendar before work begins.

Local showroom access. Our Mesa and Scottsdale showrooms give you a place to review materials and discuss design decisions in person.

Workmanship coverage with clear terms. Our construction workmanship warranty lasts 10 years or until the home is sold, whichever comes first. Products carry their manufacturers’ warranties, with separate terms and coverage.
